listing.name: Viewtiful Joe 2 — viewtiful-joe-2-recompiled (goldilocks00)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reaches native Capcom and game title screens, menus, first combat and movement. Progress stops at Slow tutorial02. An audio signal was detected, but quality, saves, the first level and the full game have not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own GameCube Europe G2VP08 revision0.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the source build with your own CISO: run fetch_sources.py, optionally bootstrap_deps.py, then the documented tools/project.sh tools/prepare/build/run sequence. This generates local DolRecomp and runtime files; it does not download the game.

warnings: The project reaches native Capcom and game title screens, menus, first combat and movement. Progress stops at Slow tutorial02. An audio signal was detected, but quality, saves, the first level and the full game have not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
